when: Asks the owner to review a pull request. Usually a job keyed pr:<org>/<repo>/<number>.
Asks where something stands or what happens next.
Asks how a feature works, or why it was built that way.
Reports a problem a user or customer has. Often a job keyed incident:<id> or workItem:<id>.
Asks the owner to test or validate a change they own (a PR, a deployment to a test ring, a dev instance) and report back. Usually a job keyed pr:<org>/<repo>/<number>.
Asks about a release, a rollout, a flag, or a deployment.
Asks the owner to decide, approve, or commit to a date. Always a draft.
Personal or social talk that still needs a reply.
Needs a reply, and fits nothing above.
Needs nothing from the owner: thanks, FYI, emoji, small talk.
